name: Gain
description: Adjusts the amplitude/volume of the audio signal

name: Low-Pass Filter
description: Removes high frequencies based on cutoff frequency, creates muffled sound

name: High-Pass Filter
description: Removes low frequencies, creates thin, bright sound

name: Crush
description: Bit-crushing effect for retro, lo-fi digital distortion and glitchy sounds

name: Distortion
description: Adds harmonic distortion for aggressive, overdriven sound

name: Delay
description: Creates echo/repeat effects by delaying the audio signal

name: Reverb
description: Simulates room/space acoustics for ambient, spacious sound

name: Pan
description: Positions sound in stereo field from left to right

name: Sine Wave
description: Pure sine wave oscillator, smooth and fundamental tone

name: Sawtooth Wave
description: Rich, bright waveform with harmonics, classic synth sound

name: Square Wave
description: Hollow, woody waveform with odd harmonics, classic chiptune sound

name: Triangle Wave
description: Soft, flute-like waveform with gentle harmonics

name: Noise
description: White noise generator for percussion, wind, or texture effects

name: FM Synthesis
description: Frequency modulation synthesis for metallic, bell-like tones

name: AM Synthesis
description: Amplitude modulation synthesis for tremolo and ring modulation effects

name: Arpeggiator
description: Automatically plays notes in sequence, creates running patterns

name: Sequencer
description: Programs note patterns and rhythms in steps

name: Slow
description: Slows down the pattern by repeating each step multiple times

name: Fast
description: Speeds up the pattern by dividing each step

name: Stretch
description: Stretches pattern across multiple cycles

name: Loop
description: Repeats a pattern for specified number of cycles

name: Random
description: Randomly selects values from provided options for generative patterns

name: Euclidean Rhythm
description: Generates rhythmic patterns using Euclidean algorithm for world music rhythms

name: Mute
description: Silences specific steps or tracks in the pattern

name: Density
description: Increases note density by adding random notes to pattern

name: Chunk
description: Groups pattern elements into chunks for polyrhythmic effects

name: Note
description: Specifies musical notes with octave information

name: Scale
description: Constrains notes to a specific musical scale

name: Chord
description: Plays multiple notes simultaneously as chords

name: Transpose
description: Shifts all notes up or down by semitones
